##### Project general facts

Oud Residences, developed by Eagle Hills, is located on the picturesque Maryam Island in Sharjah, offering a selection of studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. The project embodies a refined contemporary architectural style, combining elegant design with functional layouts to create a comfortable and sophisticated waterfront living environment. With premium finishes and thoughtfully planned interiors, it represents a modern lifestyle in one of Sharjah’s most sought-after island destinations.

Residents of Oud Residences enjoy access to a wide range of premium lifestyle amenities designed to enhance comfort and wellbeing. These include state-of-the-art fitness centers, temperature-controlled swimming pools, children’s play areas, barbecue zones, and beautifully landscaped gardens. The development also benefits from 24/7 security and direct beach access, offering a relaxed coastal atmosphere with uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf.

The interiors feature premium finishing with high-quality materials, ensuring durability and refined aesthetics throughout the living spaces. The kitchens are fully equipped with appliances, combining practicality with modern design. The units are delivered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to personalize their homes according to their individual style and preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Maryam Island is located in downtown Sharjah overlooking the Arabian Sea. It provides easy access to Sharjah and the neighbouring Emirates of Dubai, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain via the Al Taawun and Al Ittihad Roads.  

Set to take the tourism industry of Sharjah by storm, Maryam Island promises to be the ultimate leisure and lifestyle destination with a range of alluring amenities and unique gastronomical offerings.  

Combined with the utmost privacy, the serene residential spaces offer visitors, tenants, owners, and guests the experience of a lifetime, with a relaxing promenade and a wealth of upscale amenities.
